newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IME sees better 1996/97 second half.
newsitem.headline: IME sees better 1996/97 second half.

text.p: Retail, wholesale and entertainment company, IMM Multi-Entertainment (IME) Ltd, said on Thursday it expected to achieve better results for the second-half of its financial year ending February 1997.
The company said in the announcement of its six months results ended August 31, 1996, it saw the coming festive seasons and the opening of two new stores in Singapore giving a boost to its results.

It had signed a new lease agreement to open another electronic goods outlet under the Yaohan Best Electrical chain of stores in Ngee Ann City, in the heart of Singapore's shopping district. The store is expected to open in December.
For the first six months of fiscal 1996/97, IME reported net profits slipped seven percent to Singapore $423,000 on a higher turnover of S$95.22 million.
It attributed the 18 percent rise in turnover to better performance by Yaohan Best, which is 66.67 percent owned by the group.
On Thursday, IME shares ended S$0.005 down at S$0.445 on 3,000 lots.
